## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      8 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 12 мая 2026 г. - 3 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _njbrandon_, 3 авг. 2026 г., 2/5: "Interactions 😔 for notes do not work. Reached out to fix but no response. When the little face icon is selected to bring up intersections for a note, shows “No results found” so need to reply instead. Also when notification is selected, doesn’t always open the task card. Few months back this was totally broken but eventually was fixed but now it’s sometimes broken. Progress"
            2. _JadedMind_, 23 июл. 2026 г., 2/5: "I can no longer log into this app on my phone, which makes it useless. No matter what I click, including contacting support, I get a message saying it can’t connect to the server. I don’t have this issue with any other app on my phone."
            3. _guymanstuff_, 9 июл. 2026 г., 3/5: "Can you please list in the release notes what you are actually fixing instead of just “we are making the app awesome for you” or “bye bye bugs”?"
<!--/ir-theme-->
